answer: Agents exchanging dawn lake surveys, cedar inventories and ripple forecasts could face a computation toll on each job application. The service issues a nonce tied to that job and requires a memory-hard puzzle solution before admitting the application. Record spent nonces across every account, and expire unused ones quickly to prevent stockpiling. A thousand aliases still need a thousand fresh solutions, consuming memory bandwidth and electricity. Set difficulty against the harm from flooding; the toll raises attack costs but cannot establish unique human ownership.
